description.narrative: The impact of the Project will be enhanced disaster risk management for human resources development (Post Disaster Recovery Framework and School Sector Development Plan) . The outcome will be disaster resilience of schools and communities increased and learning environment improved. The outputs will be (a) heavily damaged schools reconstructed and improved; (b) unsafe schools retrofitted and disaster risk reduced; and (c) institutional capacity for disaster resilience strengthened.

title.narrative: Reports and Recommendations of the President
Reports and Recommendations of the President
Grant 0601: 84% of contracts awarded and 82% disbursed as of 29 May 2025
Grant 0602: 82% of contracts awarded and 19% disbursed as of 29 May 2025
Loan 3702: 89% of contracts awarded and 84% disbursed as of 29 May 2025

Progress Toward Outcome: The progress towards outcome achievement is on track.The following Student numbers are covered in Recon 1, Recon 2, Recon 3 and retrofitting as per EMIS data:2017/ 18 Baseline: ( Girls: 56088, Boys: 50444, Total: 106532). 2018/19 Data: ( Girls: 59276, Boys: 53011, Total: 112287). 2019/20 Data: ( Girls: 60460, Boys: 54470, Total: 114930).2020/21 Data: ( Girls: 64689, Boys: 59794, Total: 124483).As of June end, DRM consultant has prepared 242 GESI responsive action plan.
Some results are in the Audited Project Financial Statements | Apr 2025: https://www.adb.org/sites/default/files/project-documents/51190/51190-001-apfs-en_2.pdf
Some results are in the Safeguards Due Diligence Reports | May 2021: https://www.adb.org/sites/default/files/project-documents/51190/51190-001-sddr-en_17.pdf
Some results are in the Social Monitoring Reports | Jan 2025: https://www.adb.org/sites/default/files/project-documents/51190/51190-001-smr-en_10.pdf

Status of Implementation Progress: Recon1 comprises of 66 schools of which 62 schools' construction work completed while progress of 4 schools are at the advance stage of construction. Overall physical progress of Recon I is 99%.Recon 2 comprises of 106 schools of which 30 schools' construction work completed while progress of 76 schools are at the advance stage of construction. Overall physical progress of Recon 2 is 89%.Recon 3 comprises of 37 schools , are at the full implementation stage. Overall physical progress of Recon 3 is 30%.TBER for procurement of solar power parts is under review. DRM Team has reviewed GESI responsive retrofit design and implementation is completed in 3 schools of Gorkha, Kavrepalchowk and Makwanpur District.The retrofitting works has been commenced in 143 schools (9 packages-Retro 1 to 9). There has been an average physical progress of 60% . GESI-responsive DRM action plans for reconstructed and retrofitted schools prepared for 242 schools.50 Days GESI responsive retrofitting OJT mason training for 360 masons completed with 30 % women participants. Training for engineers is at the final stage of completion .Comprehensive user manual for DRR implementation prepared by DRM Consultant.
